| # XCP on CAN {#xcp-on-can-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                 |                                                                                                                     |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

XCP on CAN/CAN-FD is supported as a transport layer. The selection of either CAN or CAN-FD as the transport layer can be configured in easyConfig.

The transport layer uses version number 1.2, as defined in the ASAM standard.

+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ![Notice](notice.png){style="margin:0;width:8.3333in;height:0.4479in;border:none"}                 |
+====================================================================================================+
| \- XCP is configured on CAN channel 3 by default, with default Baud rate is 1000K (in easyConfig). |
|                                                                                                    |
| \- The request and response commands are of CAN Standard frame format:                             |
|                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                    |
|   Master Node(REQUEST):    2045 (Default)                                                          |
|   ------------------------ ----------------                                                        |
|   Slave Node (RESPONSE):   2046 (Default)                                                          |
|                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                    |
| The default IDs and the CAN channel can be changed using easyConfig.                               |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
